text: Brought in a bike that had sat in my shed for six years. Two days later it rode like new and the bill was lower than I feared.
They fitted new brake pads and trued both wheels while I waited. No upselling, just a clear list of what actually needed doing.
Good, honest mechanics. Took an extra day because a part was on backorder, but they called me right away to explain.
I was nervous about taking my carbon road bike to a local shop. They treated it like their own, and the shifting has never been smoother.
Quick flat repair before a ride with the kids and they would not even let me pay. I bought my helmets here the next week.
The tune-up itself was good but the shop was busy and nobody acknowledged me for a while. Worth the wait for the quality of the work.
Rebuilt the drivetrain on my commuter and showed me how to keep it clean. I learned more in ten minutes than in a year of guessing.
My bike came back with the rear derailleur still skipping. They took it back and fixed it, but I had to make two trips.
Found me a used kids bike in great shape and adjusted it on the spot for my son. Fair price and a big smile from him.
Solid shop, knowledgeable staff, decent selection of lights and locks. I wish the opening hours were longer in winter.
Spoke replacement on a wheel everyone else said was a write-off. Two hours, forty dollars, and it is perfectly true.
They set up my e-bike battery mount properly and explained the warranty clearly. Rare to find that kind of patience.
Fast turnaround on a seasonal service. The mechanic spotted a cracked chainring I had missed. Thanks for the heads up.
Bike fit session was worth every penny. My knee pain is gone after one adjustment to the saddle height.
Fair work but I was quoted one price on the phone and a slightly higher one at pickup. They explained why, but a heads up first would be better.
Early morning drop-off before work, ready by dinner. Brakes feel brand new. Will be back in spring.
Helped me pick my first proper touring bike and did not push the most expensive one. I trust them completely.
